text:
Alisa (PM): quick async pulse for Q3 OKR milestones — keeping this compact. Post one line per owner: what shipped, what slipped, immediate next step + ETA. I’ll collate.
Dave (Eng): infra autoscale work slipped from EOW -> new ETA 2024-09-10. blocker: missing cloud quota request approval.
Meera (Eng-Platform): noted. I filed the quota request (cloud-support#554) yesterday, pinged infra-ops. If approved by EOD tomorrow we can hit 9/10. :crossed_fingers:
Nate (ML Eng): model routing rollout shipped yesterday to canary (10%). Metrics look fine, latency +1ms. Rolling to 100% on Monday if no regressions. Next: open PR for rollout dashboard (PR#812).
Sam (SWE): feature flagging infra changed behaviour — CR needed. @Dave can you review PR#809? small patch, tests added.
Dave (Eng): will take a look by EOD. if I don't, @Sam ping me in the morning. :thumbsup:
Jen (Design): shipped updated UX for model picker; deployed to staging. One visual polish left (button spacing) — targeting Friday.
Alisa (PM): nice. Can each owner also list a single dependency (team/person) we need to unblock this week? I'll surface to leadership.
Nate (ML Eng): dep: infra infra-autoscale quotas (Meera). Also need logging hook from eng-logging (Dave) for tracing; quick PR pending.
Meera (Eng-Platform): dep: cloud-support approval + security review for KMS change (security-team). Security review scheduled Thu.
Sam (SWE): dep: Dave review PR#809 and design sign-off (Jen). After that I can cut release branch.
Dave (Eng): dep: SRE on the canary alert thresholds — @eng-sre please confirm thresholds, otherwise I'll set conservative ones.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment recorded: model-routing-v3 -> 10% (1765130200). Checks: health=ok, error-rate=0.02%.
Alisa (PM): consolidated quick table for leadership:

```
Shipped: model-routing canary (Nate), UX staging (Jen)
Slipped: autoscale infra (Meera) -> new ETA 2024-09-10
Next steps: PR reviews (Dave/Sam), quota approval (Meera), rollout dashboard PR (Nate)
```
Alisa (PM): action owners I’ll follow up with individually: Meera (quota + security), Dave (PR + alerts), Sam (release branch), Nate (dashboard). Expect a short update Monday AM.
Sam (SWE): CR pinged again to make sure it’s visible: https://git.internal/r/pr/809 :eyes:
Dave (Eng): reviewed PR#809, left one nit. will approve after tests green.
Nate (ML Eng): PR#812 opened: adds rollout metrics + waterfall view. reviewers @Dave @Meera please.
Meera (Eng-Platform): security reviewer assigned. if anything blocks, I’ll escalate.
Jen (Design): pushed spacing fix to staging. visually good now. :sparkles:
Alisa (PM): thanks team. anything else that should be in the snapshot for execs? keep replies short.
Dave (Eng): add note: risk low but we need quota confirmation; otherwise fallback plan is to throttle queues.
Alisa (PM): added. final: please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve completed your immediate next step this week so I can close the sync.
Sam (SWE): ✅
Nate (ML Eng): ✅
Jen (Design): ✅
Meera (Eng-Platform): will update once quota approved (pending). :hourglass:
Dave (Eng): ✅ (PR will be approved once tests pass)
Alisa (PM): perfect — closing this thread for now, I’ll post the compiled one-line summary to #all-hands Monday. :wave:
